T: Move in with Grandma. Eat like it.
D: A video game tester gets evicted and moves in with his grandma and her two housemates.
P: Serve the snacks when Alex moves in with Grandma.
S: Cheese, crackers and pickled onions on a plate, the snack plate at Grandma's. Arrange 250g cheddar, 200g crackers and a jar of pickled onions on a plate.
Pizza rolls with pepperoni and cheese for the office couch. Roll 500g pizza dough, spread with sauce, top with 100g pepperoni and 150g mozzarella, roll up, slice and bake at 200C for 18 minutes.
M: Glazed beef meatloaf with mashed potatoes and peas, Grandma's Sunday dinner. Mix 800g beef mince, 1 onion, 1 egg and 60g breadcrumbs, shape a loaf, glaze with 100ml tomato sauce and bake at 180C for 1 hour.
W: Little cinnamon tea cakes, the kind Grandma has with her afternoon tea. Beat 100g butter and 120g sugar, add 2 eggs, then 200g self-raising flour and 120ml milk.
K: A proper pot of black tea with milk and sugar.

s.how: Arrange 250g cheddar, 200g crackers and a jar of pickled onions on a plate. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.
Roll 500g pizza dough, spread with sauce, top with 100g pepperoni and 150g mozzarella, roll up, slice and bake at 200C for 18 minutes. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.how: Mix 800g beef mince, 1 onion, 1 egg and 60g breadcrumbs, shape a loaf, glaze with 100ml tomato sauce and bake at 180C for 1 hour. Serve with 800g mashed potatoes and peas.

w.how: Beat 100g butter and 120g sugar, add 2 eggs, then 200g self-raising flour and 120ml milk. Bake in 12 muffin holes at 180C for 18 minutes, brush with butter and roll in cinnamon sugar.

d.how: Warm a teapot, add 4 tsp black tea and 1L boiling water and brew 4 minutes. Serve with milk and sugar. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
